faqs.question: How does Strive tailor consulting solutions to our specific industry?
faqs.answer: We begin every engagement with a comprehensive diagnostic audit of your operational workflows, competitive landscape, and financial objectives. Our multidisciplinary specialists then craft a custom roadmap aligned with your exact KPIs.

faqs.question: What is the typical timeline for an enterprise transformation project?
faqs.answer: Initial strategic assessments typically conclude within 2 to 4 weeks, while full-scale digital and operational implementations range from 8 to 16 weeks with measurable milestone deliverables every sprint.

faqs.question: Can we integrate the Strive platform with our existing ERP and CRM tools?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our platform features pre-built connectors and REST/GraphQL APIs compatible with SAP, Salesforce, HubSpot, Oracle, and custom internal databases.

faqs.question: Can we upgrade or switch our subscription plan at any time?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. You can scale your plan up or down directly from your administrator dashboard at any time, with prorated billing applied automatically.

faqs.question: Do you offer custom enterprise invoicing and annual discounts?
faqs.answer: Yes, organizations opting for annual billing receive a 20% discount, and we support custom PO invoicing and wire transfers for Enterprise clients.

faqs.question: What level of technical support is included with our plan?
faqs.answer: All plans include access to our documentation portal and support desk. Professional and Ultimate plans include 24/7 live chat, phone support, and a dedicated customer success manager.

faqs.question: Do you provide onboarding training for our internal staff?
faqs.answer: Yes, our team conducts live virtual or on-site workshops and provides recorded training modules to ensure smooth adoption across your organization.
